title: Why Division by Zero Is Undefined
subject: Mathematics
objective: A calculator says ERROR for 12 ÷ 0 because no number times 0 gives 12. It is not infinity either.

fill.q: a ÷ b = c means c × b = ____.
For 0 ÷ 0, every number works, so there is no ____ answer.

tf.explain: Any number c satisfies c × 0 = 0, so no single answer.

tf.q: 12/x becomes very large as x gets close to 0.
tf.explain: But it is +∞ on one side and −∞ on the other.

ar.explain: R shows why no answer exists.
A is false (every number works, so no unique answer); R is true.

options: every number works, so no unique answer

mcq.q: Division is defined as the reverse of:
mcq.explain: a ÷ b = c ⇔ c × b = a.

short.q: Explain using multiplication why 8 ÷ 0 is undefined.
short.solution: 8 ÷ 0 = c would need c × 0 = 8. But c × 0 = 0 for every c, so no c exists.
Infinity is not a number; also 8/x goes to +∞ from one side and −∞ from the other, so no single value.

match.explain: Check every division by turning it into multiplication.
